basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old avid gamer and Sims enthusiast from Seattle, who recently joined Reddit to delve deeper into the world of custom content for The Sims. I work as a graphic designer during the day, which leaves my evenings free to explore new CC and mods. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends either gaming or hiking in the nearby mountains. I usually browse Reddit late at night, often between 9 PM and 1 AM. I don't like overly complicated mods and prefer user-friendly ones. I'm still learning the ropes of Reddit, especially with all the unwritten rules and etiquette.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in gaming and modding for The Sims, with a background in graphic design which aids in understanding visual mods. I often rely on online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial-and-error to troubleshoot issues.
